{{Top|leg}}
The '''Load Spider THK 421''' was a type of [[Shuttle/Legends|cargo shuttle]] produced by [[Bespin Motors/Legends|Bespin Motors]]. It was used extensively during the construction of [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]].<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|258|Load Spider THK 421}}</ref>
